name: Arcade

abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Steadfast: Aktifken, Unblockable saldırılar sanki değillermiş gibi bloklanabilir.
abilityDetails.Torment: Gelen tüm hasar veren debuff'ların süresini uzatır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): 3 jeton biriktirince %100 otomatik blok yapar (sersemletir+şok uygular), bu isabetli-saldırı tipi yeteneklerle önlenemez (isabet hassasiyetini %100 azaltır) — sadece Abalo (impact) bonuslu şampiyonlar (örn. Gorr) yok sayabilir. Yere serilince 2 jeton kaybeder — bu yüzden dövüşe ağır saldırılarla başla. E1 zehir bulutu uygular (jeton kazandırır), bu yüzden hep E2'ye zorla. Ağır saldırıları otomatik bloklayamaz.
signatureAbility:
Welcome To Murderworld!
Just before Arcade Auto-Blocks an attack, gain a non-stacking Steadfast Buff for [2 - 10] seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks. This will not trigger if the attack is a Heavy Attack, or if the Opponent has an Undermine effect.
When the Opponent enters a Poisonous Cloud, inflict a [5 - 15]% Torment Debuff for 8 seconds. This starts paused, and is unpaused when the Opponent exits the Poisonous Cloud. Max stacks: 3.
immunityDetails:
• Yakma Bağışıklığı 🔥
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• Şok Bağışıklığı (kozmikler hariç) ⚡️

abilitySections.title: Persistent Prize Tickets - Max: 5
content: Arcade starts each Quest with 3 Persistent Prize Tickets. When winning a fight as an Attacker, convert 50% of all Arcade Tokens into Persistent Prize Tickets (rounded down). If a fight is won with fewer than 2 Arcade Tokens, gain 1 Persistent Prize Ticket anyways.

Persistent Prize Tickets can be spent in the Pre-Fight Screen to activate a Fabulous Prize. Fabulous Prizes can only be used by Arcade, and last until his Opponent is defeated. These are always active as a Defender.

abilitySections.title: Pre-Fight Ability - Fabulous Prizes
content: Power-Up: Personal effects and the Stun from the Parry Mastery gain +100% Ability Accuracy. If Arcade is not fighting a Cosmic Champion, he also gains Incinerate Immunity. Costs 1 Persistent Prize Ticket.

Cheat Code: The Opponent's True Strike, True Accuracy, and True Sense effects suffer -100% Ability Accuracy. If Arcade is not fighting a Cosmic Champion, he also gains Poison Immunity. Costs 2 Persistent Prize Tickets.
Game Wizard: The duration of personal Damaging Debuffs cannot be reduced. If Arcade is not fighting a Cosmic Champion, he also gains Shock Immunity. Costs 3 Persistent Prize Tickets.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Arcade does not benefit from the Collar Tech Mastery. Instead, he gains +[269.85] Attack Rating for each rank invested and reduces the Opponent's Defensive Combat Power Rate by 7% for each unique personal Damaging Debuff on them.
As an Attacker, Arcade's fourth Light Attack disables his Special Attack 3 for 0.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Arcade Tokens - Max: 10
content: Whenever the Opponent would be Poisoned, Arcade gains 1 Arcade Token. As a Defender, he gains 1 additional Arcade Token if a Poison is not prevented by Immunity, and gains 3 on the final hit of Special Attack 2 on hit, Block or Dodge.
Each Arcade Token increases Armor Rating and the potency of personal Damaging Debuffs by 10%. When knocked down, lose 2 Arcade Tokens.

While Arcade has 10 Arcade Tokens, or 3 or more as a Defender, he gains an indefinite Auto-Block Passive granting a 100% chance to Auto-Block incoming attacks. Arcade cannot Auto-Block the Opponent's Heavy Attacks.
With 2 or more Arcade Tokens, Arcade also has a 100% chance to Auto-Block attacks while charging or releasing his own Heavy Attack.
When Auto-Blocking an attack, inflict a Shock Debuff dealing [10,784] Energy Damage over 3 seconds, trigger the Parry Mastery if it is active, and consume 8 Arcade Tokens, or 3 as a Defender.

abilitySections.title: Trap - Poisonous Cloud
content: After the second hit of his Heavy Attack, Arcade deploys a Poisonous Cloud. Poisonous Clouds last for 10 seconds, and active Poisonous Clouds are removed when deploying a new one.

When the Opponent enters a Poisonous Cloud, gain 1 Arcade Token. Each second the Opponent is inside the Poisonous Cloud, they are inflicted with a Poison Debuff dealing [6,296.5] Direct Damage over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Trap - Booby Trap
content: At the start of each fight, a Booby Trap is placed in the Defender's corner. The Booby Trap will not be placed if the Opponent is also Arcade.
While the Opponent is on top of the Booby Trap, they are 60% more likely to launch a Special Attack.

If the Opponent is not performing a Special Attack and they are on top of the Booby Trap, charging or releasing Arcade's Heavy Attack causes it to explode and Passively Stuns the Opponent for 3 seconds.
While the Opponent is inside of a Poisonous Cloud and they are Stunned by this explosion, the existing Poisonous Cloud will be refreshed instead of deploying a new one.
After exploding, the Booby Trap goes on standby for 20 seconds, or 10 seconds as a Defender. As an Attacker, this expires 15% faster per unique personal Damaging Debuff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: After the second hit of this attack, deploy a Poisonous Cloud at the Opponent's location.
Electricity hits inflict Shock Debuffs each dealing [3,598] Energy Damage over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Flamethrower hits inflict Incinerate Debuffs each dealing [8,095.5] Energy Damage over 20 seconds.
Buzz Saw hits inflict Bleed Debuffs each dealing [8,095.5] Direct Damage over 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Randomly inflict an indefinite Bleed, Rupture, or Shock Debuff that deals [719.6] damage per second.

When the Opponent enters a Poisonous Cloud, inflict a [5 - 15]% Torment Debuff for 8 seconds. This starts paused, and is unpaused when the Opponent exits the Poisonous Cloud. Max stacks: 3.
